scanNote:
WORKBOOK 15-UNITNING BIRINChI BETI (62-bet, PDF 60). Yuqorida to'q sariq yorliqda 'UNIT 15', yonida katta qora 'Surf the Net!'.

CHAP USTUN - 'Vocabulary':
1a) 'Match the items in the two columns to form phrases, as in the example.' current, World Wide, e-mail, surfing, download, web, computer | screen, the net, events, information, sites, Web, message. Strelka: current → events.
1b) 'Read the on-line dialogues and fill in the phrases from above. There is one phrase that you do not need.' DIALOG 1: Wolf > Are you there, Gail? Gail > Hi Wolf - yes I'm here - did you get my 1) ......? Wolf > Yeah, I got it just now. Sorry I didn't have the chance to check my mail earlier - I was too busy 2) ...... Gail > Did you find any good 3) ......? Wolf > Well, I found a great site called Music Mania. You can 4) ...... on all the best groups. You can even download songs and video clips! (RASM: globus ustida qo'l berishayotgan ikki odam silueti.) DIALOG 2: Flyer > Are you on-line, Aries? Aries > Hi Flyer - what have you been doing? Flyer > I've been catching up on 5) ...... on the net. What about you? Aries > I've been doing boring housework. My 6) ...... was really dirty. At least I can see what you're saying now! Flyer > Yuck! Housework! Surfing the net is much more fun, isn't it?

O'NG USTUN:
2) 'How do you print something from the net? Put the instructions in the correct order.' SURAT: kompyuter oldidagi bola (naushnik bilan). a Wait for the document to be downloaded and the page to appear on your screen. b Decide which part of the document you want to copy. c Click on the print symbol to print your selection. d Enter the address of the web site. e Wait for your computer to be connected to the web site.
3) 'Cross the odd word out. Give reasons, as in the example.' 1 modem, radio (chizilgan), mouse, keyboard (the others are used with computers). 2 go skiing, join a newsgroup, make new friends, listen to music. 3 send e-mail, post a letter, make a phone call, download a document. 4 but, however, in conclusion, on the other hand. 5 advantages, disadvantages, pros, good points.
• 'Grammar':
4) 'Underline the correct word.' 1 A: Guess what? I won first prize in the competition! B: What/How wonderful! 2 A: Somebody stole Jake's car. B: What/How a pity! It was brand new. 3 A: Ruby's moving to France! B: What/How a surprise! Why is she moving there? 4 A: Guess where John and I are going this summer? Brazil! B: What/How exciting! 5 A: I was stuck in traffic for hours! B: What/How terrible! 6 A: Look at the diamond ring George gave me for our wedding anniversary. B: What/How a gorgeous gift!

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '62'.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the items in the two columns to form phrases, as in the example: current, World Wide, e-mail, surfing, download, web, computer | screen, the net, events, information, sites, Web, message. Example: current events.
exercises.instructionUz: Ikki ustundagi bandlarni moslab iboralar tuzing, namunadagidek: current, World Wide, e-mail, surfing, download, web, computer | screen, the net, events, information, sites, Web, message. Namuna: current events.
exercises.explanationUz:
INTERNET IBORALARI (coursebook
  104-bet).

  current EVENTS - joriy voqealar
    (yangiliklar)
  World Wide WEB - Butunjahon
    to'ri (WWW)
  e-mail MESSAGE - elektron xat
  surfing THE NET - internetda
    kezish
  download INFORMATION - ma'lumot
    yuklab olmoq
  web SITES - veb-saytlar
  computer SCREEN - kompyuter
    ekrani


⚠ 'THE NET' = 'THE INTERNET':

  Qisqa shakl. 'surf the Net' =
  internetda kezmoq.


⚠ 'TO DOWNLOAD':

  = yuklab olmoq (internetdan
  kompyuterga).


⚠ 'CURRENT':

  = joriy, hozirgi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the on-line dialogues and fill in the phrases from above. There is one phrase that you do not need.
exercises.instructionUz: Onlayn dialoglarni o'qing va yuqoridagi iboralarni qo'ying. Bitta ibora ortiqcha.
exercises.explanationUz:
ONLAYN SUHBAT (chat) - 1999.

  1 e-mail message - xatimni oldingmi
  2 surfing the net - band edim
  3 web sites - yaxshi saytlar
  4 download information -
    ma'lumot yuklab olish
  5 current events - yangiliklar
  6 computer screen - ekran iflos

  ⚠ ORTIQChA: 'World Wide Web'.


⚠ 'TO CATCH UP ON':

  = o'tkazib yuborilgan narsani
  bilib olmoq (yangiliklar).


⚠ 'AT LEAST':

  = hech bo'lmaganda.


⚠ 'YUCK!':

  = Uf! (jirkanish).


⚠ 'ON-LINE':

  = internetda (ulangan).


⚠ 'ISN'T IT?':

  = shundaymi? (question tag).

lines.speaker: Gail
lines.en: Hi Wolf - yes I'm here - did you get my 1) ___?
lines.uz: Salom Volf - ha, shu yerdaman - elektron xatimni oldingmi?

lines.speaker: Wolf
lines.en: Yeah, I got it just now. Sorry I didn't have the chance to check my mail earlier - I was too busy 2) ___
lines.uz: Ha, hozirgina oldim. Kechirasan, pochtamni avvalroq tekshirishga imkonim bo'lmadi - internetda kezish bilan band edim.

lines.speaker: Wolf
lines.en: Well, I found a great site called Music Mania. You can 4) ___ on all the best groups. You can even download songs and video clips!
lines.uz: Music Mania degan ajoyib sayt topdim. Eng yaxshi guruhlar haqida ma'lumot yuklab olish mumkin. Hatto qo'shiq va videokliplar ham!

lines.speaker: Aries
lines.en: Hi Flyer - what have you been doing?

lines.speaker: Flyer
lines.en: I've been catching up on 5) ___ on the net. What about you?

lines.speaker: Aries
lines.en: I've been doing boring housework. My 6) ___ was really dirty. At least I can see what you're saying now!
lines.uz: Zerikarli uy ishlarini qilyapman. Kompyuter ekranim juda iflos edi. Hech bo'lmaganda endi nima deyayotganingni ko'ra olaman!
lines.whyUz: ⚠ 'computer screen was dirty' → endi ko'ra oladi.

lines.speaker: Flyer
lines.en: Yuck! Housework! Surfing the net is much more fun, isn't it?
lines.uz: Uf! Uy ishlari! Internetda kezish ancha qiziqroq, shundaymi?

exercises.instructionEn: How do you print something from the net? Put the instructions in the correct order. a Wait for the document to be downloaded and the page to appear on your screen. b Decide which part of the document you want to copy. c Click on the print symbol to print your selection. d Enter the address of the web site. e Wait for your computer to be connected to the web site.
exercises.instructionUz: Internetdan qanday chop etasiz? Ko'rsatmalarni to'g'ri tartibda joylashtiring. a Hujjat yuklanishi va sahifa ekranda paydo bo'lishini kuting. b Hujjatning qaysi qismini nusxalashni hal qiling. c Tanlovingizni chop etish uchun chop etish belgisini bosing. d Veb-sayt manzilini kiriting. e Kompyuteringiz veb-saytga ulanishini kuting.
exercises.explanationUz:
INTERNETDAN ChOP ETISh - TARTIB:

  1 d - manzilni kiriting
  2 e - ulanishni kuting
  3 a - yuklanishni kuting
  4 b - qismni tanlang
  5 c - chop etish belgisini bosing


⚠ 'TO ENTER THE ADDRESS':

  = manzilni kiritmoq (terib).


⚠ 'TO BE CONNECTED TO':

  = ... ga ulanmoq (majhul).


⚠ 'TO CLICK ON':

  = ... ni bosmoq (sichqoncha).


⚠ 'YOUR SELECTION':

  = tanlovingiz (tanlangan qism).

pairs.right: d - Enter the address of the web site.
e - Wait for your computer to be connected to the web site.
a - Wait for the document to be downloaded and the page to appear on your screen.
b - Decide which part of the document you want to copy.
c - Click on the print symbol to print your selection.

exercises.instructionEn: Cross the odd word out. Give reasons, as in the example. Example: modem, radio, mouse, keyboard - radio (the others are used with computers).
exercises.instructionUz: Ortiqcha so'zni chizib tashlang. Sabab ayting, namunadagidek. Namuna: modem, radio, mouse, keyboard - radio (qolganlari kompyuter bilan ishlatiladi).
exercises.explanationUz:
ORTIQChA SO'Z:

  1 radio - qolganlari kompyuter
    qismlari
  2 go skiing - qolganlari
    internetda qilinadi
  3 post a letter - qolganlari
    elektron/telefon aloqa
  4 in conclusion - qolganlari
    qarama-qarshilik bog'lovchilari
  5 disadvantages - qolganlari
    ijobiy tomonlar


⚠ 'A NEWSGROUP':

  = yangiliklar guruhi (internet
  forumi).


⚠ 'PROS AND CONS':

  = ijobiy va salbiy tomonlar.
  pros = advantages = good points
  cons = disadvantages


⚠ 'IN CONCLUSION':

  = xulosa qilib.

items.whyUz: ⚠ NAMUNA. The others are used with computers.

items.textEn: 2 go skiing, join a newsgroup, make new friends, listen to music
items.uz: chang'i uchish, yangiliklar guruhiga qo'shilish, yangi do'st orttirish, musiqa tinglash
items.whyUz: ⚠ The others can be done on the Internet (qolganlarini internetda qilish mumkin).

items.textEn: 3 send e-mail, post a letter, make a phone call, download a document
items.uz: e-mail yuborish, xat jo'natish, qo'ng'iroq qilish, hujjat yuklab olish
items.whyUz: ⚠ The others use electronic/telephone communication (qolganlari elektron aloqa).

items.textEn: 4 but, however, in conclusion, on the other hand
items.uz: lekin, ammo, xulosa qilib, boshqa tomondan
items.whyUz: ⚠ The others show contrast (qolganlari qarama-qarshilik bog'lovchilari).

items.uz: afzalliklar, kamchiliklar, ijobiy tomonlar, yaxshi tomonlar
items.whyUz: ⚠ The others are positive points (qolganlari ijobiy tomonlar).

exercises.explanationUz:
UNDOV GAPLAR (coursebook 108-bet
  qoidasi).

  HOW + SIFAT! - 'How wonderful!',
    'How exciting!', 'How terrible!'
  WHAT A(N) + (SIFAT) + OT! - 'What
    a pity!', 'What a surprise!',
    'What a gorgeous gift!'

  ⚠ KALIT: keyin OT bo'lsa → WHAT
  (a); faqat SIFAT → HOW.


⚠ 'WHAT A PITY!':

  = Afsus! ('pity' - ot).


⚠ 'BRAND NEW':

  = yap-yangi.


⚠ 'STUCK IN TRAFFIC':

  = tirbandlikda qolib ketgan.


⚠ 'GORGEOUS':

  = juda chiroyli, ajoyib.

items.textEn: A: Guess what? I won first prize in the competition! B: What/How wonderful!
items.uz: Bilasanmi? Musobaqada birinchi o'rinni oldim! - Qanday ajoyib!

items.textEn: A: Somebody stole Jake's car. B: What/How a pity! It was brand new.
items.uz: Kimdir Jeykning mashinasini o'g'irladi. - Qanday afsus! U yap-yangi edi.

items.textEn: A: Ruby's moving to France! B: What/How a surprise! Why is she moving there?
items.uz: Rubi Fransiyaga ko'chyapti! - Qanday kutilmagan! Nega u yerga ko'chyapti?

items.textEn: A: Guess where John and I are going this summer? Brazil! B: What/How exciting!
items.uz: Jon bilan bu yozda qayerga borishimizni top! Braziliya! - Qanday qiziq!

items.textEn: A: I was stuck in traffic for hours! B: What/How terrible!
items.uz: Soatlab tirbandlikda qolib ketdim! - Qanday dahshat!

items.textEn: A: Look at the diamond ring George gave me for our wedding anniversary. B: What/How a gorgeous gift!
items.uz: Jorj nikoh yubileyimizga bergan olmos uzukka qara. - Qanday ajoyib sovg'a!
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'a gorgeous gift' - sifat + ot → What a.
